description: This is a unit test class for the 'ThingDeleted' class within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things' package. It contains tests for immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling related to the 'ThingDeleted' event in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ThingDeletedTest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for the 'ThingDeleted' event class, testing aspects like immutability, JSON serialization, equality, and correct exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the 'ThingDeleted' class is immutable and that 'Thing' objects used with it are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of 'hashCode' and 'equals' methods in 'ThingDeleted' using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating a 'ThingDeleted' instance with a null 'ThingId' string throws a 'ThingIdInvalidException'.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that passing a null 'ThingId' object to create a 'ThingDeleted' instance results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the 'toJson' method of 'ThingDeleted' produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: fromJsonWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Validates that parsing a JSON string into a 'ThingDeleted' object reproduces the expected object state.
